summary: Avis Budget Group filed an 8-K to report entry into the Eleventh Amendment to its Sixth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, refinancing its existing $2 billion revolving facility with a new $2 billion facility maturing June 29, 2031, and establishing a new $200 million revolving facility maturing June 29, 2028. The amendment is a routine refinancing of credit lines, creating a direct financial obligation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is involved. The filing contains no deal terms, premiums, or close dates. This is a standard credit agreement amendment, not a special-situation event.
